bullets.text: In Taramani and Velachery, sewage is blocked five feet high in closed drains due to a metro work contractor, causing severe flooding, and the office should monitor drainage clearance.
Cyclone warning signals were hoisted at nine ports across Tamil Nadu and Puducherry, including Chennai and Ennore, and the office should track weather developments closely.
In Puzhal, Thiruvallur, a dangerous situation occurred when police chased a suspect during an attempted arrest, and the district team should watch for further updates.
Residents in Velachery and other Chennai areas flagged safety risks after silt cleared from canals and stormwater drains was left piled along roadsides, and the office should coordinate removal.
The state government requires about 300 meters of a Greater Chennai Corporation road to double the Beach-Fort MRTS bottleneck, and the constituency team should track land handover progress.
The Pallikaranai marsh has become a year-round home for hundreds of spot-billed pelicans feeding and breeding, and the office should ensure continued environmental protection of the marshland.

In Avadi Corporation, streetlights remain unlit despite a twenty-two crore rupee contract being awarded, causing darkness and fear, and the district team should inspect the electrical maintenance work.
In Minjur panchayat, residents besieged a block development officer during an inspection of canal work ahead of the monsoon, and the office should ensure proper flood mitigation execution.
In Thiruvallur district, continuous rains increased water inflow and raised water levels in lakes, and the district team should monitor water storage and supply channels.

MeitY Secretary S Krishnan stated that India's cyber security agency flagged 303 government and critical-sector websites as vulnerable to PHP language flaws, and the portfolio team should review state portals.
The Office of the Inspector General of Registration is inviting private companies to run twenty-five model registration hubs in Chennai, and the IT team should oversee the digital service rollout.
NCERT introduced a twenty-hour artificial intelligence and computational thinking module for Classes 9 to 12, and the department should watch educational technology integration across schools.
DMK President M K Stalin criticized the ruling government regarding rising prices and corruption, calling for a united opposition, and the office should monitor political developments.
Tamizhaga Vazhvurimai Katchi leader Velmurugan questioned the Tamil Nadu government regarding law and order and ruling party members' excesses, and the office should watch political reactions.
AMMK General Secretary TTV Dhinakaran criticized the ruling government over rising essential commodity prices, and the portfolio team should track opposition statements.
